candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500s: 7 unhandled_request_failure ERROR logs and error_rate 0.16 with p95 440ms, while gateway traces show ERROR calls to order (1913ms) and order checkout spans ERROR (1350ms).
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause of the 500s is not identified; no downstream error detail captured.

report.explanation: Current telemetry shows order service HTTP 500s and elevated error rate/latency propagating to gateway. Deployment record (3.1.9, 1733 min old) does not establish causation. No evidence supports db-pool, redis, memory-leak, or bad-config causes; the specific failing dependency remains unidentified.
missing_evidence: Order service error logs with exception/stack detail to identify the failing code path
Downstream dependency (inventory, payment, postgresql) latency and error metrics during the window
Order service traces with child span status to localize the failing dependency
